packageRules.description: Homebrew/actions tags are CalVer with a 4th daily-increment segment (e.g. 2026.09.13.1). Renovate's default github-actions versioning parses/coerces via strict semver, which only keeps the first 3 numeric segments - it silently truncates this to 2026.09.13, a ref that doesn't exist, so digest lookups fail (surfaced on the Dependency Dashboard as 'Could not determine new digest for update'). Loose versioning compares all numeric segments as-is with no truncation.
